messages:
Alex Nguyen: Handoff to @Maria — I'm leaving for the evening, leaving you the night coverage (00:00-08:00 UTC). Main things to watch: gpu-pool-prod utilization, burst tokens, and the AcmeCorp training window at 02:00 UTC.

Maria Chen: Thanks — quick Q: what's current pool headroom and how do I check burst tokens?

Alex Nguyen: Current snapshot from 15m ago: gpu-pool-prod (us-east-1) at ~88% GPU utilization, average token throughput ~120k tokens/min, burst tokens remaining 1,200/5,000. To check live: `redwoodctl pool status --name gpu-pool-prod --region us-east-1` and to get per-node GPU util: `kubectl top pods -n inference --selector=pool=gpu-pool-prod`.

Jon Park: FYI the canary model rollout for rwlm-v2 is scheduled tomorrow 09:00 UTC, shouldn't affect tonight but caching behavior changed in the last build so keep an eye on memory OOMs.

Maria Chen: Copy. If gpu util >95% or burst tokens drop below 500, what should I do first?

Alex Nguyen: Escalation playbook: 1) Try `redwoodctl pool scale --name gpu-pool-prod --delta 2` (this invokes reserved burst if available). 2) If scale fails or no burst tokens, temporarily route non-critical routes to cpu-fallback: `redwoodctl route set --tag low-priority --model cpu-fallback`. 3) Open an incident only if latency >2s P95 or error rate spikes >1%. Slack ping @eng-sre and @oncall.

Sree Pillai: Also watch prefix cache hit rate — low hit rate causes extra tokens. `redwoodctl metrics query "cache_prefix_hit_ratio{pool=\"gpu-pool-prod\"}"`. If <40%, consider enabling short-lived prefix cache for heavy A/B tests.

OncallBot: Automated alert: queue_length(gpu-pool-prod) crossed 50 for 2 minutes at 2025-11-02T01:58:00Z — no action taken (info).

Maria Chen: I see the alert in CloudWatch too. I'll keep an eye during the AcmeCorp window. If queue >100 and P95 >1.5s, I'll route low-priority.

Alex Nguyen: Two other notes: - There's a scheduled infra patch at 04:30 UTC on worker-42 (non-disruptive rolling), but that node hosts a few higher-memory GPUs — monitor pod evictions. - Weekend burst credits are lower because of earlier test runs; current total pool burst left = 1,200 (as above).

Jon Park: If you need additional headroom and burst exhausted, we can temporarily scale a dedicated test pool into prod (manual, takes ~6-8min). Ping me if you need that and include exact timestamps.

Maria Chen: Got it. I'll slack here with short updates at 02:15 and 03:30 and ping @Jon and @Sree if I hit the thresholds.

Alex Nguyen: One last thing — customers on Dedicated tier (AcmeCorp) have autosurge enabled. Expect a short-lived spike at start of their session. If their traffic disrupts hosted customers, prioritize hosted SLOs per routing policy (see runbook). Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/gpu-capacity-playbook (copy in case you need full steps). :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: Thanks Alex — taking over. Leaving runbook open, will update thread with any actions. :raised_hands:
